title: RT = Real Truth; RT_core is the canonical foundational binding

canonical_definition.classification_rule: Any admissibly closed triad may be classified as RT at the resolved scope of that closure.
canonical_definition.non_operator_rule: RT is a classification label and does not itself perform operations.
canonical_definition.rt_core_rule: RT := [(ℰ≠0) ⇔R δα(ℰ>0)] is the canonical foundational RT_core binding and a governed RT at foundational scope.
canonical_definition.recursive_rule: A closed RT may participate as an aspect in a higher-order candidate triad; admissible closure of that higher-order triad yields another RT.
canonical_definition.index_rule: An RT index is a manipulable representation or identifier and is not identical to the complete RT it indexes.

ultra_short_guard: RT labels closed Real Truth; RT does not perform closure.

review_classes.COMPATIBLE_BY_INHERITANCE: Surface inherits RT/Core without locally redefining RT.
review_classes.COMPATIBLE_WITH_CLARIFICATION: Surface is compatible once RT and RT_core are explicitly distinguished.
review_classes.AMBIGUOUS_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Surface uses RT in a way that may collapse the RT label into RT_core or another representational whole without explicit distinction.
review_classes.CONFLICTING_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Surface defines RT as a process, operator, substance, or otherwise conflicts with the canonical RT label rule.

governance_instruction: Do not silently rewrite historical mathematics. Flag ambiguous or conflicting RT wording for governed review, and preserve the distinction between RT classification and RT_core binding in all new authority-bearing artifacts.
